experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_mutations.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv. 2. Compute per‐patient TMB by counting mutations per patient_id. 3. Extract expression values for genes GZMA and PRF1 from the expression matrix; aggregate to patient level as the mean if multiple samples. 4. Compute a cytolytic score as the geometric mean or sum of GZMA and PRF1 expression for each patient. 5. Merge TMB and cytolytic score with patient demographic covariates (age_at_diagnosis, gender) from clinical data. 6. Compute Spearman correlation between TMB and cytolytic score; report rho and p‐value. 7. Fit a linear regression model predicting cytolytic score from TMB adjusting for age and gender; report coefficients and R². 8. Generate a scatter plot of TMB vs cytolytic score with regression line.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Spearman correlation coefficient (rho) and p‐value between TMB and cytolytic score.  • Linear regression output: coefficients, standard errors, p‐values, and R².  • Scatter plot of TMB vs cytolytic score with fitted regression line.  • Table of patient_id, TMB, GZMA, PRF1, and cytolytic score.

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Primary tumors with ulceration (ulceration_indicator = YES) display upregulated expression of inflammatory cytokine genes IL6 and TNF compared to non‐ulcerated tumors.

experiment_plan.objective: To compare IL6 and TNF expression between ulcerated and non‐ulcerated melanoma tumors.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv. 2. From clinical data, select patients with ulceration_indicator labeled YES or NO; exclude missing. 3. Extract log2(FPKM+0.001) expression for IL6 and TNF for each sample and aggregate to patient level by mean. 4. Merge patient‐level IL6 and TNF expression with ulceration status. 5. For each gene (IL6, TNF), perform Wilcoxon rank‐sum test comparing expression in ulcerated vs non‐ulcerated groups; apply Bonferroni correction. 6. Optionally, fit logistic regression models predicting ulceration status from IL6 and TNF expression adjusting for age and gender. 7. Create boxplots of IL6 and TNF expression stratified by ulceration status.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Table of Wilcoxon test statistics and adjusted p‐values for IL6 and TNF.  • Logistic regression outputs if performed: odds ratios, 95% CI, and p‐values.  • Boxplots of IL6 and TNF expression by ulceration status.  • Merged dataset preview: patient_id, ulceration_indicator, IL6, and TNF expression.

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Prior systemic therapy is associated with altered expression of DNA damage repair (DDR) genes (BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, ATR, TP53) in melanoma tumors.

experiment_plan.objective: To test whether patients who received prior systemic therapy exhibit differential expression in key DDR genes compared to therapy‐naïve patients.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv. 2. From clinical data, categorize patients by prior_systemic_therapy (YES vs NO). 3. Extract expression values for DDR genes BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, ATR, and TP53; aggregate multiple samples per patient by mean. 4. Merge patient‐level DDR gene expression with therapy status and covariates (age_at_diagnosis, gender). 5. For each DDR gene, perform Wilcoxon rank‐sum test comparing expression in treated vs untreated groups; correct for multiple testing using Benjamini–Hochberg. 6. Optionally, perform a pathway‐level Gene Set Enrichment Analysis on the DDR gene set between groups. 7. Visualize with boxplots for each gene.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Table of gene‐wise Wilcoxon statistics and FDR‐adjusted p‐values for BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, ATR, TP53.  • Boxplots of DDR gene expression stratified by prior systemic therapy.  • Optional GSEA enrichment score and p‐value for the DDR gene set.  • Merged table: patient_id, prior_systemic_therapy, and DDR gene expressions.

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Presence of BRAF mutations is associated with reduced expression of MHC class I genes (HLA-A, HLA-B, B2M) in melanoma.

experiment_plan.objective: To evaluate whether BRAF‐mutant tumors show lower MHC I gene expression relative to BRAF wild‐type tumors.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_mutations.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv. 2. Identify patients with any somatic mutation in Hugo_Symbol 'BRAF'; label as BRAF‐mutant or wild‐type. 3. From expression data, extract patient‐level mean expression for HLA-A, HLA-B, B2M. 4. Merge mutation status with MHC I expression and adjust for covariates (age_at_diagnosis, gender). 5. For each MHC I gene, perform Wilcoxon rank‐sum test comparing expression between BRAF‐mutant and wild‐type groups; correct p‐values for multiple comparisons. 6. Fit linear regression models predicting each gene’s expression from BRAF status adjusting for age and gender. 7. Generate boxplots of HLA‐A, HLA‐B, and B2M expression by mutation status.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Wilcoxon test results and adjusted p‐values for each MHC I gene.  • Regression outputs: coefficients for BRAF status with 95% CI and p‐values for each gene.  • Boxplots comparing expression of HLA-A, HLA-B, B2M in mutant vs wild‐type.  • Table of patient_id, BRAF status, and MHC I gene expressions.

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Molecular subtypes defined by unsupervised clustering of the top 500 most variable genes exhibit distinct overall survival outcomes.

experiment_plan.objective: To discover expression‐based subtypes via clustering and test their association with survival.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_gene_expression.csv and cleaned_clinical_data.csv. 2. Calculate variance for each gene across all samples; select the top 500 most variable genes. 3. Standardize (z‐score) expression values of these genes per sample. 4. Perform hierarchical clustering (e.g., Ward’s method) or consensus clustering to define clusters (k=2–4); choose optimal k by silhouette score or consensus metrics. 5. Assign cluster labels to each patient. 6. Merge cluster labels with clinical survival data (vital_status, days_to_death, days_to_last_followup). 7. Perform Kaplan–Meier analysis stratified by cluster; compute log‐rank test p‐value. 8. Visualize heatmap of the 500 genes ordered by cluster, and plot survival curves.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Cluster assignment file: patient_id and subtype label.  • Heatmap of clustered expression matrix (top 500 genes).  • Kaplan–Meier survival curves for each subtype with log‐rank p‐value.  • Silhouette scores or consensus metrics supporting cluster number choice.

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) lab results are associated with greater Breslow thickness and higher tumor mutational burden.

experiment_plan.objective: To evaluate whether LDH result categories correlate with tumor thickness and mutation burden.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_mutations.csv. 2. From clinical data, select patients with lactate_dehydrogenase_result labeled “Normal” or “Elevated”; drop missing. 3. Extract breslow_thickness from clinical and compute per‐patient TMB from mutations. 4. Merge lactate_dehydrogenase_result, Breslow thickness, and TMB into one table. 5. For Breslow thickness, perform Wilcoxon rank‐sum test comparing Normal vs Elevated LDH; repeat for TMB. 6. Optionally, fit two linear regression models: Breslow_thickness ~ LDH + age + gender, and TMB ~ LDH + age + gender. 7. Visualize boxplots of Breslow thickness and TMB by LDH category.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Wilcoxon test results (statistic and p‐value) for Breslow thickness and TMB comparisons.  • Regression outputs if performed: coefficients for LDH with 95% CIs and p‐values.  • Boxplots of Breslow thickness and TMB by LDH status.  • Merged table: patient_id, LDH result, Breslow thickness, and TMB.

tried_experiments.hypothesis: Higher tumor expression of the immune checkpoint gene CD274 (PD-L1) is associated with improved overall survival in melanoma patients.

experiment_plan.objective: To test whether patients with above‐median CD274 expression have longer overall survival compared to those with below‐median expression.
experiment_plan.steps: 1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv. 2. From the expression matrix, extract the log2(FPKM+0.001) values for gene CD274 for each sample. 3. Map samples to patients by matching the first 12 characters of the barcode; if multiple samples per patient exist, use the mean CD274 expression. 4. Merge patient‐level CD274 expression with clinical survival data (vital_status, days_to_death, days_to_last_followup). 5. Dichotomize patients into “High CD274” (expression ≥ median) and “Low CD274” (expression < median). 6. Perform Kaplan–Meier survival analysis comparing overall survival between the two groups; compute log‐rank test p‐value. 7. Fit a Cox proportional hazards model with CD274 expression (continuous) adjusting for age_at_diagnosis and gender; report hazard ratios and p‐values.
experiment_plan.deliverables: • Kaplan–Meier survival curves for High vs Low CD274 groups with 95% confidence intervals and log‐rank p‐value.  • Cox model summary: hazard ratio for CD274, 95% CI, and p‐value, plus coefficients for age and gender.  • Table of patient_id, CD274 expression, group assignment, survival time, and event status.

experiment_plan.objective: To test whether tissue collection strategy influences measured TMB.

From clinical data, extract tissue_prospective_collection status (YES vs NO). 4. Merge TMB with prospective_collection status. 5. Compare TMB distributions between YES and NO groups using Wilcoxon rank‐sum test. 6. Fit a linear regression of TMB on prospective_collection status adjusting for age_at_diagnosis and gender. 7. Experiment objective: Compare TMB across categories of distant metastasis site.

Steps for the programmer:

7. Optionally, visualize with a grouped boxplot.

• Kruskal–Wallis test statistic and p‐value.  
• Post‐hoc Dunn’s test results (adjusted p‐values).  
• Table of patient_id, metastasis category, and TMB.

{"code":"import subprocess
import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import kruskal
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data
print("Loading clinical and mutation data...")
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)

# Compute TMB per patient
print("Computing tumor mutational burden (TMB)...")
tmb = mutations.groupby('patient_id').size().rename('TMB').reset_index()

# Categorize distant metastasis site
def categorize(site):
    if pd.isna(site):
        return 'None'
    s = str(site).lower()
    if s == 'lung':
        return 'Lung'
    if s == 'skin':
        return 'Skin'
    if 'lymph' in s:
        return 'Lymph node'
    return 'Other'

clinical['metastasis_category'] = clinical['distant_metastasis_site'].apply(categorize)

# Merge TMB with clinical categories
merged = pd.merge(tmb, clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'metastasis_category']],
                  left_on='patient_id', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner')
merged = merged.drop(columns=['bcr_patient_barcode'])
print(f"Merged data: {merged.shape[0]} patients with defined categories and TMB.")

# Prepare data for statistical tests
categories = ['Lung', 'Skin', 'Lymph node', 'Other', 'None']
data_groups = [merged.loc[merged['metastasis_category'] == cat, 'TMB'].values for cat in categories]

# Kruskal-Wallis test
print("Performing Kruskal-Wallis test...")
kw_stat, kw_p = kruskal(*data_groups)
print(f"Kruskal-Wallis H = {kw_stat:.3f}, p = {kw_p:.3e}")

# Post-hoc Dunn's test
try:
    import scikit_posthocs as sp
except ImportError:
    install('scikit-posthocs')
    import scikit_posthocs as sp

print("Performing Dunn's post-hoc test with Bonferroni correction...")
dunn = sp.posthoc_dunn(merged, val_col='TMB', group_col='metastasis_category', p_adjust='bonferroni')
print("Dunn's test p-values:")
print(dunn)

# Boxplot visualization
import seaborn as sns
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='metastasis_category', y='TMB', data=merged, order=categories)
plt.title('TMB by Distant Metastasis Site Category')
plt.xlabel('Metastasis Category')
plt.ylabel('Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Display merged table summary
print("Merged table preview (patient_id, category, TMB):")
print(merged[['patient_id', 'metastasis_category', 'TMB']].head(10).to_string(index=False))
print(f"... ({merged.shape[0]} total patients) ")"}

hypothesis: Patients with elevated lactate dehydrogenase activity—as approximated by high LDHA gene expression—exhibit higher tumor proliferation (mitotic count) and a distinct proliferation‐related gene expression signature compared to patients with low LDHA expression.

experiment_plan.objective: Extend the differential‐expression analysis by testing whether a curated proliferation gene set (e.g., Hallmark E2F targets) is significantly enriched among genes upregulated in High-LDHA patients.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def install(pkg):
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', pkg])

# Imports
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene')
    import mygene
try:
    import gseapy
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy')
    import gseapy

mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()

# 1. Load clinical and expression data
df_clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', dtype=str)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map LDHA to Ensembl and extract
res = mg.query('LDHA', scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl', species='human')
hit = res.get('hits', [{}])[0]
ensembl = hit.get('ensembl')
if isinstance(ensembl, list): ensembl_id = ensembl[0]['gene']
elif isinstance(ensembl, dict): ensembl_id = ensembl['gene']
else: raise KeyError('LDHA Ensembl not found')
mask = expr.index.to_series().str.startswith(ensembl_id)
ldha_row = expr.loc[mask].iloc[0]

# 3. Patient-level LDHA expression
df_ldha = pd.DataFrame({
    'bcr_patient_barcode': [s[:12] for s in ldha_row.index],
    'LDHA_expr': ldha_row.values
})
df_ldha = df_ldha.groupby('bcr_patient_barcode', as_index=False).mean()

# 4. Merge with clinical and filter
df = pd.merge(df_ldha, df_clin, on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner')
df['mitotic_count_per_mm2'] = pd.to_numeric(df['mitotic_count_per_mm2'], errors='coerce')
df['age_at_diagnosis'] = pd.to_numeric(df['age_at_diagnosis'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['mitotic_count_per_mm2','age_at_diagnosis','gender','LDHA_expr'])

# 5. Dichotomize High vs Low
median = df['LDHA_expr'].median()
df['LDHA_group'] = np.where(df['LDHA_expr']>=median, 'High','Low')
print("Sample counts per LDHA group:\n", df['LDHA_group'].value_counts().to_string())

# 6. Mitotic count t-test
gh = df[df['LDHA_group']=='High']['mitotic_count_per_mm2']
gl = df[df['LDHA_group']=='Low']['mitotic_count_per_mm2']
tstat,pval = stats.ttest_ind(gh, gl, equal_var=False)
print(f"\nMitotic count comparison: High mean={gh.mean():.2f}, Low mean={gl.mean():.2f}")
print(f" t={tstat:.3f}, p={pval:.3e}\n")

# 7. Patient-level expression
expr.index = expr.index.str.split('.').str[0]
expr.columns = [s[:12] for s in expr.columns]
expr_pt = expr.groupby(expr.columns, axis=1).mean()
patients = df['bcr_patient_barcode'].tolist()
expr_sub = expr_pt[patients]

# 8. Differential expression via OLS
frame = df.copy()
frame['group_code'] = (frame['LDHA_group']=='High').astype(int)
frame['gender_male'] = (frame['gender']=='MALE').astype(int)
X = sm.add_constant(frame[['group_code','age_at_diagnosis','gender_male']])
results = []
for gene in expr_sub.index:
    y = expr_sub.loc[gene, patients].values
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    results.append((gene, model.params['group_code'], model.pvalues['group_code']))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue'])
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')
print(f"Number of DE genes at FDR<0.05: {res_df[res_df['FDR']<0.05].shape[0]}\n")

# 9. Enrichment: Hallmark_2020 via Enrichr
gs = gseapy.get_library(name='Hallmark_2020', source='Enrichr')
e2f = gs.get('HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS', [])
if not e2f: raise KeyError('HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS not found')
# map to Ensembl
genes_map = mg.querymany(e2f, scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl', species='human')
gene_set = set()
for h in genes_map:
    e = h.get('ensembl')
    if isinstance(e,list): gene_set.add(e[0]['gene'])
    elif isinstance(e,dict): gene_set.add(e['gene'])

# Fisher's test
res_df['gene_id'] = res_df['gene']
all_genes = set(res_df['gene_id'])
up_genes = set(res_df[(res_df['logFC']>0)&(res_df['FDR']<0.05)]['gene_id'])
M = len(all_genes & gene_set)
K = len(up_genes)
X_ = len(up_genes & gene_set)
tbl = [[X_, M-X_],[K-X_, len(all_genes)-M-K+X_]]
or_,pf = stats.fisher_exact(tbl)
print("Fisher's Exact Test:")
print(f" Overlap = {X_}/{M}")
print(f" Odds ratio = {or_:.2f}, p-value = {pf:.3e}\n")

# 10. Volcano plot
res_df['neglogp'] = -np.log10(res_df['pvalue'])
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(res_df['logFC'], res_df['neglogp'], c=np.where(res_df['FDR']<0.05,'red','gray'), s=5)
plt.xlabel('Log2FC')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 p')
plt.title('Volcano: High vs Low LDHA')
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', ls='--')
plt.axvline(0, color='black', lw=0.5)
plt.show()

Experiment objective: Because clinical LDH annotations are too sparse, use LDHA gene expression as a continuous proxy for LDH activity. Test whether high LDHA expression correlates with increased mitotic counts and distinct differential expression of proliferation genes.

Steps for the programmer:
1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_gene_expression.csv; match samples to patients via first 12 characters of sample barcode.  
2. Map HUGO symbol “LDHA” to its Ensembl gene ID using mygene; extract its expression row per sample.

4. Dichotomize patients into “High‐LDHA” vs “Low‐LDHA” groups based on the median LDHA expression.  
5. Compare mitotic_count_per_mm2 between High vs Low groups using a two‐sample t-test (or Wilcoxon if non‐normal).  
6. Fit gene‐wise linear models (OLS) across all genes to identify differential expression between High vs Low LDHA, adjusting for age and gender. Apply FDR correction and select genes with FDR<0.05.  
7. (Optional) Use a proliferation gene set (e.g., Hallmark E2F targets) and test for enrichment among DE genes via Fisher’s exact test or preranked GSEA with a GMT file.  
8. Generate a volcano plot of log2‐fold changes vs –log10(p‐values).  
9. Summarize: group counts, mitotic count test statistics, table of DE genes, volcano plot, and enrichment results if available.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Install and import mygene
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "mygene"])
    import mygene
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()

# 1. Load data
df_clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', dtype=str)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map LDHA to Ensembl and extract its expression
res = mg.query('LDHA', scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl', species='human')
h = res.get('hits', [{}])[0]
ensembl = h.get('ensembl')
if isinstance(ensembl, list): ensembl_id = ensembl[0]['gene']
elif isinstance(ensembl, dict): ensembl_id = ensembl['gene']
else: raise KeyError('LDHA Ensembl not found')
mask = expr.index.to_series().str.startswith(ensembl_id)
ldha_row = expr.loc[mask].iloc[0]
# Patient-level LDHA: strip sample IDs and average duplicates
df_ldha = pd.DataFrame({'bcr_patient_barcode': [s[:12] for s in ldha_row.index],
                        'LDHA_expr': ldha_row.values})
df_ldha = df_ldha.groupby('bcr_patient_barcode', as_index=False)['LDHA_expr'].mean()

# 3. Merge with clinical and filter
df = pd.merge(df_ldha, df_clin, on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='inner')
df['mitotic_count_per_mm2'] = pd.to_numeric(df['mitotic_count_per_mm2'], errors='coerce')
df['age_at_diagnosis'] = pd.to_numeric(df['age_at_diagnosis'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['mitotic_count_per_mm2','age_at_diagnosis','gender','LDHA_expr']).copy()

# 4. Dichotomize High vs Low LDHA
median_ldha = df['LDHA_expr'].median()
df['LDHA_group'] = np.where(df['LDHA_expr']>=median_ldha, 'High', 'Low')
print("Sample counts per LDHA group:\n", df['LDHA_group'].value_counts().to_string())

# 5. Mitotic count comparison
gh = df[df['LDHA_group']=='High']['mitotic_count_per_mm2']
gl = df[df['LDHA_group']=='Low']['mitotic_count_per_mm2']
tstat, pval = stats.ttest_ind(gh, gl, equal_var=False)
print(f"\nMitotic count comparison:\n High mean={gh.mean():.2f}, Low mean={gl.mean():.2f}")
print(f" t-statistic={tstat:.3f}, p-value={pval:.3e}\n")

# 6. Prepare patient-level gene expression
gene_expr = expr.copy()
gene_expr.columns = [s[:12] for s in gene_expr.columns]
# aggregate duplicate patient columns by mean
gene_expr = gene_expr.groupby(gene_expr.columns, axis=1).mean()
patients = df['bcr_patient_barcode'].tolist()
gene_expr_sub = gene_expr[patients]

# 7. Differential expression via OLS
# Design matrix
df['group_code'] = (df['LDHA_group']=='High').astype(int)
df['gender_male'] = (df['gender']=='MALE').astype(int)
X = sm.add_constant(df[['group_code','age_at_diagnosis','gender_male']])
results = []
for gene in gene_expr_sub.index:
    y = gene_expr_sub.loc[gene, patients].values
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    results.append((gene, model.params['group_code'], model.pvalues['group_code']))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue'])
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')
print(f"Number of DE genes at FDR<0.05: {res_df[res_df['FDR']<0.05].shape[0]}\n")

# 8. Enrichment analysis via Fisher's exact test
# Load proliferation gene set from GMT
gmt_file = 'Hallmark_E2F_targets.gmt'
gene_set = []
with open(gmt_file) as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if 'E2F' in parts[0]:
            gene_set = parts[2:]
            break
if not gene_set:
    raise FileNotFoundError('Proliferation gene set not found in GMT')
# Map gene symbols to Ensembl IDs
map_res = mg.querymany(gene_set, scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl', species='human')
set_ensembl = set()
for hit in map_res:
    e = hit.get('ensembl')
    if isinstance(e, list): set_ensembl.add(e[0]['gene'])
    elif isinstance(e, dict): set_ensembl.add(e['gene'])
# Prepare DE sets
res_df['gene_id'] = res_df['gene'].str.split('.').str[0]
all_genes = set(res_df['gene_id'])
up = set(res_df.loc[(res_df['logFC']>0)&(res_df['FDR']<0.05), 'gene_id'])
# Contingency table
M = len(all_genes & set_ensembl)
K = len(up)
X = len(up & set_ensembl)
table = [[X, M-X], [K-X, len(all_genes)-M-K+X]]
or_, p_fisher = stats.fisher_exact(table)
print("Fisher's exact test for proliferation gene set:")
print(f" Overlap (upregulated ∩ set) = {X} of {M} genes in set")
print(f" Odds ratio = {or_:.2f}, p-value = {p_fisher:.3e}\n")

# 9. Volcano plot
res_df['neglogp'] = -np.log10(res_df['pvalue'])
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(res_df['logFC'], res_df['neglogp'], c=np.where(res_df['FDR']<0.05,'red','gray'), alpha=0.5, s=5)
plt.xlabel('Log2 Fold Change (High vs Low)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 p-value')
plt.title('Volcano Plot of Differential Expression')
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.5)
plt.show()

# Note: Preranked GSEA not implemented
print('Preranked GSEA analysis not implemented.')"}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
import statsmodels.api as sm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Step 1: Load data
print("Loading clinical and mutation data...")
df_clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
df_mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)

# Step 2 & 3: Filter clinical and compute BMI
df_clin = df_clin.dropna(subset=['height_cm', 'weight_kg']).copy()
df_clin['BMI'] = df_clin['weight_kg'] / (df_clin['height_cm'] / 100) ** 2

# Step 4: Count total mutations per patient
mut_counts = df_mut.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='mutation_count')

# Step 5: Merge BMI with mutation counts (using patient barcode)
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'BMI']],
    mut_counts,
    left_on='bcr_patient_barcode',
    right_on='patient_id'
)

# Step 6: Compute correlations
spearman_res = spearmanr(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'])
pearson_res = pearsonr(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {spearman_res.correlation:.3f}, p-value = {spearman_res.pvalue:.3e}")
print(f"Pearson correlation: r = {pearson_res[0]:.3f}, p-value = {pearson_res[1]:.3e}\n")

# Step 7: Fit linear regression model
X = sm.add_constant(df_merged['BMI'])
y = df_merged['mutation_count']
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
print(model.summary())

# Deliverable: Table of BMI and mutation counts per patient
print("\nTable of BMI and mutation counts per patient (first 10 rows):")
print(df_merged[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'BMI', 'mutation_count']].head(10))
print(f"Total patients in analysis: {df_merged.shape[0]}\n")

# Step 8: Plot BMI vs mutation count with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'], alpha=0.6)
# Regression fit line
bmi_range = np.linspace(df_merged['BMI'].min(), df_merged['BMI'].max(), 100)
preds = model.params['const'] + model.params['BMI'] * bmi_range
plt.plot(bmi_range, preds, color='red', label='Fit: mutation_count ~ BMI')
plt.xlabel('BMI')
plt.ylabel('Mutation Count')
plt.title('BMI vs Mutation Count with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
import statsmodels.api as sm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Step 1: Load data
print("Loading clinical and mutation data...")
df_clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
df_mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)

# Step 2 & 3: Filter clinical and compute BMI
df_clin = df_clin.dropna(subset=['height_cm', 'weight_kg']).copy()
df_clin['BMI'] = df_clin['weight_kg'] / (df_clin['height_cm'] / 100) ** 2

# Step 4: Count total mutations per patient
mut_counts = df_mut.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='mutation_count')

# Step 5: Merge BMI with mutation counts (using patient barcode)
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'BMI']],
    mut_counts,
    left_on='bcr_patient_barcode',
    right_on='patient_id'
)

# Step 6: Compute correlations
spearman_res = spearmanr(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'])
pearson_res = pearsonr(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {spearman_res.correlation:.3f}, p-value = {spearman_res.pvalue:.3e}")
print(f"Pearson correlation: r = {pearson_res[0]:.3f}, p-value = {pearson_res[1]:.3e}\n")

# Step 7: Fit linear regression model
X = sm.add_constant(df_merged['BMI'])
y = df_merged['mutation_count']
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
print(model.summary())

# Deliverable: Table of BMI and mutation counts per patient
print("\nTable of BMI and mutation counts per patient (first 10 rows):")
print(df_merged[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'BMI', 'mutation_count']].head(10))
print(f"Total patients in analysis: {df_merged.shape[0]}\n")

# Step 8: Plot BMI vs mutation count with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(df_merged['BMI'], df_merged['mutation_count'], alpha=0.6)
# Regression fit line
bmi_range = np.linspace(df_merged['BMI'].min(), df_merged['BMI'].max(), 100)
preds = model.params['const'] + model.params['BMI'] * bmi_range
plt.plot(bmi_range, preds, color='red', label='Fit: mutation_count ~ BMI')
plt.xlabel('BMI')
plt.ylabel('Mutation Count')
plt.title('BMI vs Mutation Count with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', dtype=str)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Verify and preprocess 'ethnicity'
if 'ethnicity' not in clinical.columns:
    raise ValueError("Clinical data must contain 'ethnicity' column.")
clin = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'ethnicity']].dropna()
clin['ethnicity'] = clin['ethnicity'].str.upper().str.strip()
# 3. Keep major groups
groups = ['NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO']
clin = clin[clin['ethnicity'].isin(groups)]

# Map samples to patients and filter
samples = expr.columns.tolist()
patients = [s[:12] for s in samples]
mask = [p in set(clin['bcr_patient_barcode']) for p in patients]
expr_filt = expr.loc[:, mask]
samples_filt = expr_filt.columns.tolist()
patients_filt = [s[:12] for s in samples_filt]

# Subset clinical to filtered patients
meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': samples_filt, 'patient': patients_filt})
meta = meta.merge(clin, left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode')

# 5. Select top 5000 most variable genes
gene_vars = expr_filt.var(axis=1)
top_genes = gene_vars.nlargest(5000).index
dat = expr_filt.loc[top_genes].T  # samples x genes

# 6. Determine optimal k via silhouette (k=2..6)
best_k, best_score = 2, -1
scores = {}
for k in range(2, 7):
    labels = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=0).fit_predict(dat)
    sc = silhouette_score(dat, labels)
    scores[k] = sc
    if sc > best_score:
        best_k, best_score = k, sc
print(f"Silhouette scores by k: {scores}")
print(f"Chosen k: {best_k} (score={best_score:.3f})")

# 7. Final clustering
km = KMeans(n_clusters=best_k, random_state=0).fit(dat)
meta['subtype'] = km.labels_

# 8. Contingency table and chi-square test
ct = pd.crosstab(meta['subtype'], meta['ethnicity'])
chi2, pval, _, _ = chi2_contingency(ct)
print("\nContingency table (subtype vs ethnicity):")
print(ct)

expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

expr_samples = expr.columns.tolist()
patient_codes = [s[:12] for s in expr_samples]

# 2. Filter race groups
clinical = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'race']]
clinical = clinical.dropna(subset=['race'])
# standardize race labels
clinical['race'] = clinical['race'].str.upper().str.strip()
keep_races = ['WHITE', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN']
clinical_filt = clinical[clinical['race'].isin(keep_races)]

# Filter expression samples to these patients
mask = [p in set(clinical_filt['bcr_patient_barcode']) for p in patient_codes]
expr = expr.loc[:, mask]
sample_patients = [s[:12] for s in expr.columns]

# 3. Top 5000 most variable genes
vars_ = expr.var(axis=1)
top_genes = vars_.nlargest(5000).index
expr_top = expr.loc[top_genes]

# 4. K-means clustering (k=4)
k = 4
km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=0)
clusters = km.fit_predict(expr_top.T)
cluster_series = pd.Series(clusters, index=expr_top.columns, name='subtype')

# Merge cluster and race info
meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': expr_top.columns, 'patient': sample_patients})
meta = meta.merge(clinical_filt, left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode')
meta['subtype'] = cluster_series.values

# 5. Association test
ct = pd.crosstab(meta['subtype'], meta['race'])
chi2, p, dof, exp = chi2_contingency(ct)
print("Subtype membership by race:\n", ct)

# 6. Heatmap of top 50 variable genes with race annotation
top50 = vars_.nlargest(50).index
heat_data = expr_top.loc[top50, meta['sample']]
# Define colors
sub_colors = dict(zip(range(k), sns.color_palette('Set2', k)))
race_colors = {'WHITE':'grey', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN':'black'}
col_colors = pd.DataFrame({
    'Subtype': meta['subtype'].map(sub_colors),
    'Race': meta['race'].map(race_colors)
}, index=meta['sample'])
# Plot clustermap
sns.clustermap(heat_data, row_cluster=True, col_cluster=False,
               col_colors=col_colors.values, cmap='vlag', figsize=(10,8))
plt.suptitle('Heatmap of Top 50 Variable Genes by Subtype and Race', y=1.02)
plt.show()

# Differential expression: top 10 genes per subtype
print("Top signature genes per subtype (by mean difference):")
for s in range(k):
    in_idx = meta[meta['subtype']==s]['sample']
    out_idx = meta[meta['subtype']!=s]['sample']
    means_in = expr_top[in_idx].mean(axis=1)
    means_out = expr_top[out_idx].mean(axis=1)
    mean_diff = means_in - means_out
    top_sig = mean_diff.abs().nlargest(10).index.tolist()
    print(f"Subtype {s}: {', '.join(top_sig)}")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

    raise ValueError("Clinical data must contain 'ethnicity' column.")

groups = ['NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO']
clin = clin[clin['ethnicity'].isin(groups)]

# Map samples to patients and filter
samples = expr.columns.tolist()
patients = [s[:12] for s in samples]
mask = [p in set(clin['bcr_patient_barcode']) for p in patients]
expr_filt = expr.loc[:, mask]
samples_filt = expr_filt.columns.tolist()
patients_filt = [s[:12] for s in samples_filt]

# Subset clinical to filtered patients
meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': samples_filt, 'patient': patients_filt})
meta = meta.merge(clin, left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode')
# 5. Select top 5000 most variable genes
gene_vars = expr_filt.var(axis=1)
top_genes = gene_vars.nlargest(5000).index
dat = expr_filt.loc[top_genes].T  # samples x genes

# 6. Determine optimal k via silhouette (k=2..6)
best_k, best_score = 2, -1
scores = {}
for k in range(2, 7):
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=0).fit(dat)
    sc = silhouette_score(dat, km.labels_)
    scores[k] = sc
    if sc > best_score:
        best_k, best_score = k, sc
print(f"Silhouette scores by k: {scores}")
print(f"Chosen k: {best_k} (score={best_score:.3f})")

# 7. Final clustering
km = KMeans(n_clusters=best_k, random_state=0).fit(dat)
meta['subtype'] = km.labels_

# 8. Contingency table and chi-square test
ct = pd.crosstab(meta['subtype'], meta['ethnicity'])
chi2, pval, _, _ = chi2_contingency(ct)
print("\nContingency table (subtype vs ethnicity):")
print(ct)
print(f"Chi-square test: chi2={chi2:.2f}, p-value={pval:.4f}\n")

# 9. Differential expression per subtype (t-tests)
signatures = {}
for s in sorted(meta['subtype'].unique()):
    in_samples = meta[meta['subtype']==s]['sample']
    out_samples = meta[meta['subtype']!=s]['sample']
    t_stats, p_vals = ttest_ind(expr_filt[in_samples].T.values,
                                expr_filt[out_samples].T.values, axis=0, equal_var=False)
    # adjust p-values
    _, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests(p_vals, method='fdr_bh')
    diffs = expr_filt[in_samples].mean(axis=1) - expr_filt[out_samples].mean(axis=1)
    df = pd.DataFrame({'p_adj': p_adj, 'diff': diffs}, index=expr_filt.index)
    # select genes with p_adj<0.05
    sig = df[df['p_adj']<0.05]
    if sig.shape[0] >= 50:
        top50 = sig['diff'].abs().nlargest(50).index.tolist()
    else:
        top50 = df['diff'].abs().nlargest(50).index.tolist()
    signatures[s] = top50
    print(f"Subtype {s}: {len(sig)} DE genes, signature top50: {top50[:5]}...")

# 10. Pathway enrichment placeholder
for s, genes in signatures.items():
    print(f"Subtype {s} pathway enrichment: Requires external gene sets - not implemented.")

# 11. Visualizations
# Heatmap of top 50 genes across all subtypes
sig_genes = sorted(set(sum(signatures.values(), [])))
heat_data = expr_filt.loc[sig_genes, meta['sample']]
# Column colors
sub_colors = dict(zip(sorted(meta['subtype'].unique()), sns.color_palette('Set2', best_k)))
ethn_colors = {'NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO':'grey', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO':'black'}
col_colors = pd.DataFrame({'Subtype': meta['subtype'].map(sub_colors),
                           'Ethnicity': meta['ethnicity'].map(ethn_colors)},
                          index=meta['sample'])
sns.clustermap(heat_data, row_cluster=True, col_cluster=False,
               col_colors=col_colors.values, cmap='vlag', figsize=(12, 8))
plt.suptitle('Heatmap of Signature Genes by Subtype and Ethnicity', y=1.02)
plt.show()

# Bar plot of subtype membership by ethnicity
count_df = meta.groupby(['subtype','ethnicity']).size().reset_index(name='count')
sns.barplot(x='subtype', y='count', hue='ethnicity', data=count_df)
plt.title('Subtype Membership by Ethnicity')
plt.xlabel('Subtype')
plt.ylabel('Number of Samples')
plt.show()

# 12. Save assignments
assignments = meta[['sample','patient','ethnicity','subtype']]
assignments.to_csv('subtype_assignments.csv', index=False)
print("Subtype assignments saved to 'subtype_assignments.csv'.")"}

code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
mut_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
expr_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Compute TMB per patient
mut_df['patient_id12'] = mut_df['Tumor_Sample_Barcode'].str[:12]
tmb = mut_df.groupby('patient_id12').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# 3. Prepare gene expression: strip version suffix if present
expr_df.index = expr_df.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0]
# Mapping of HUGO symbols to Ensembl gene IDs (versionless)
hugo2ensembl = {
    'PDCD1': 'ENSG00000188389',  # PD-1
    'CD274': 'ENSG00000120217',  # PD-L1
    'CTLA4': 'ENSG00000163599'   # CTLA-4
}
# Check availability
available = {h: eid for h, eid in hugo2ensembl.items() if eid in expr_df.index}
missing = set(hugo2ensembl) - set(available)
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: Missing expression data for genes: {', '.join(missing)}")

# 4. Extract and transpose to samples x genes
ensembl_ids = list(available.values())
expr_sub = expr_df.loc[ensembl_ids].T
expr_sub.columns = list(available.keys())  # rename to HUGO symbols

# 5. Map samples to patients and aggregate
expr_sub = expr_sub.reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'sample_id'})
expr_sub['patient_id12'] = expr_sub['sample_id'].str[:12]
expr_patient = expr_sub.groupby('patient_id12')[list(available.keys())].mean().reset_index()

# 6. Merge TMB and expression
data = pd.merge(tmb, expr_patient, on='patient_id12', how='inner')
# 7. Log-transform TMB
data['log2_TMB1'] = np.log2(data['TMB'] + 1)

# 8. Spearman correlation
genes = list(available.keys())
results = []
for gene in genes:
    rho, p = spearmanr(data['log2_TMB1'], data[gene], nan_policy='omit')
    results.append({'gene': gene, 'rho': rho, 'p_value': p})
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
# Adjust p-values (Bonferroni)
res_df['p_adj'] = multipletests(res_df['p_value'], method='bonferroni')[1]
print("Spearman correlation results:")
print(res_df.to_string(index=False))

# 9. Scatter plots with trend lines
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(genes), figsize=(6 * len(genes), 5))
for ax, gene in zip(np.atleast_1d(axes), genes):
    sns.regplot(x='log2_TMB1', y=gene, data=data,
                scatter_kws={'s': 20, 'alpha': 0.6}, line_kws={'color': 'red'}, ax=ax)
    rho = res_df.loc[res_df.gene == gene, 'rho'].values[0]
    p_adj = res_df.loc[res_df.gene == gene, 'p_adj'].values[0]
    ax.set_title(f"{gene}: rho={rho:.2f}, p_adj={p_adj:.3f}")
    ax.set_xlabel('log2(TMB+1)')
    ax.set_ylabel(f'{gene} expression')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Install gseapy if needed
def install(package):
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', package])
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy')
    import gseapy as gp

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Truncate sample barcodes to patient IDs and aggregate duplicates by mean expression
expr.columns = expr.columns.str[:12]
expr = expr.groupby(expr.columns, axis=1).mean()

# 3. Subset clinical data to therapy YES/NO and drop missing covariates
clin_sub = clin[clin['prior_systemic_therapy'].isin(['YES', 'NO'])].copy()
clin_sub = clin_sub.dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis', 'gender'])
clin_sub['patient_id'] = clin_sub['bcr_patient_barcode']

# 4. Align patient IDs between clinical and expression data
common_ids = np.intersect1d(expr.columns, clin_sub['patient_id'].unique())
clin_sub = clin_sub.set_index('patient_id').loc[common_ids]
expr_sub = expr.loc[:, common_ids]
# Ensure alignment
assert expr_sub.shape[1] == clin_sub.shape[0], \
    f"Mismatch: expr columns {expr_sub.shape[1]} vs clinical rows {clin_sub.shape[0]}"

# 5. Prepare design matrix
clin_sub['therapy_bin'] = (clin_sub['prior_systemic_therapy'] == 'YES').astype(int)
clin_sub['gender_bin'] = (clin_sub['gender'] == 'MALE').astype(int)
design = clin_sub[['therapy_bin', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender_bin']]
X = sm.add_constant(design)

# 6. Fit OLS per gene
genes = expr_sub.index
data_matrix = expr_sub.values  # genes x samples
results = []
for i, gene in enumerate(genes):
    y = data_matrix[i, :]
    model = sm.OLS(y, X.values)
    fit = model.fit()
    results.append((gene, fit.params[1], fit.pvalues[1]))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['gene', 'logFC', 'pvalue'])

# 7. Multiple testing correction
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_df = res_df[res_df['FDR'] < 0.05].sort_values('FDR')

print(f"Samples NO therapy: {(clin_sub['therapy_bin']==0).sum()}, YES therapy: {(clin_sub['therapy_bin']==1).sum()}")
print(f"Genes tested: {len(res_df)}, DE genes (FDR<0.05): {len(de_df)}")
print("Top 10 DE genes:")
print(de_df[['gene','logFC','pvalue','FDR']].head(10).to_string(index=False))

# 8. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(res_df['logFC'], -np.log10(res_df['pvalue']), color='grey', alpha=0.5, s=10)
sig = res_df['FDR'] < 0.05
plt.scatter(res_df.loc[sig, 'logFC'], -np.log10(res_df.loc[sig, 'pvalue']),
            color='red', alpha=0.7, s=10, label='FDR<0.05')
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2 Fold Change (therapy YES vs NO)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10(p-value)')
plt.title('Volcano Plot: Prior Systemic Therapy DE Genes')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 9. Pathway enrichment using Enrichr
up_genes = de_df.loc[de_df['logFC'] > 0, 'gene'].tolist()
down_genes = de_df.loc[de_df['logFC'] < 0, 'gene'].tolist()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Optional: install gseapy if not present
def install(package):
    import subprocess, sys
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', package])
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy')
    import gseapy as gp

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Subset clinical data to therapy YES/NO, and extract covariates
clin_sub = clin[clin['prior_systemic_therapy'].isin(['YES', 'NO'])].copy()
clin_sub = clin_sub[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'prior_systemic_therapy', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']].dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis', 'gender'])

# therapy indicator
clin_sub['therapy_bin'] = (clin_sub['prior_systemic_therapy'] == 'YES').astype(int)
# gender binary (1=MALE, 0=FEMALE)
clin_sub['gender_bin'] = (clin_sub['gender'] == 'MALE').astype(int)

# 3. Align expression data columns to patients
# Rename expr columns to patient barcodes (first 12 chars)
expr.columns = expr.columns.str[:12]
# Subset expr to patients in clin_sub
patient_ids = clin_sub['bcr_patient_barcode'].unique()
expr_sub = expr.loc[:, expr.columns.isin(patient_ids)]
# Align order: columns order matches clin_sub order
expr_sub = expr_sub[clin_sub['bcr_patient_barcode'].values]

# 4. Build design matrix
design = pd.DataFrame({
    'intercept': 1,
    'therapy': clin_sub['therapy_bin'].values,
    'age': clin_sub['age_at_diagnosis'].values,
    'gender': clin_sub['gender_bin'].values
})
X = design.values

# 5. Fit OLS per gene
results = []
for gene, y in expr_sub.iterrows():
    model = sm.OLS(y.values, X)
    fit = model.fit()
    coef = fit.params[1]  # therapy coefficient
    pval = fit.pvalues[1]
    results.append((gene, coef, pval))

res_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['gene', 'logFC', 'pvalue'])

# 6. Multiple testing correction
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
# Identify DE genes
de_df = res_df[res_df['FDR'] < 0.05].sort_values('FDR')

print(f"Patients without therapy (NO): {(clin_sub['therapy_bin']==0).sum()}, with therapy (YES): {(clin_sub['therapy_bin']==1).sum()}")
print(f"Total genes tested: {len(res_df)}, DE genes (FDR<0.05): {len(de_df)}")
print("Top 10 DE genes:")
print(de_df[['gene','logFC','pvalue','FDR']].head(10).to_string(index=False))

# 7. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
# all points
plt.scatter(res_df['logFC'], -np.log10(res_df['pvalue']), color='grey', alpha=0.5, s=10)
# highlight DE
sig = res_df['FDR'] < 0.05
plt.scatter(res_df.loc[sig, 'logFC'], -np.log10(res_df.loc[sig, 'pvalue']),
            color='red', alpha=0.7, s=10, label='FDR<0.05')
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2 Fold Change (therapy YES vs NO)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10(p-value)')
plt.title('Volcano Plot: Prior Systemic Therapy DE Genes')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Pathway enrichment using Enrichr via GSEApy
up_genes = de_df.loc[de_df['logFC'] > 0, 'gene'].tolist()
down_genes = de_df.loc[de_df['logFC'] < 0, 'gene'].tolist()

print(f"Upregulated genes (therapy YES): {len(up_genes)}; Downregulated: {len(down_genes)}")

# Enrichr analysis (KEGG 2016)
enr_up = gp.enrichr(gene_list=up_genes, gene_sets='KEGG_2016', organism='Human', outdir=None)
enr_down = gp.enrichr(gene_list=down_genes, gene_sets='KEGG_2016', organism='Human', outdir=None)

print("Top enriched pathways in upregulated genes:")
print(enr_up.results[['Term','Adjusted P-value','Overlap']].head(10).to_string(index=False))
print("\nTop enriched pathways in downregulated genes:")
print(enr_down.results[['Term','Adjusted P-value','Overlap']].head(10).to_string(index=False))
"}

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Optional: install gseapy if not available
import subprocess, sys
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", "gseapy"])
    import gseapy as gp

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Filter clinical to patients with Normal or Elevated LDH
clin_sub = clinical[clinical['lactate_dehydrogenase_result'].isin(['Normal', 'Elevated'])][
    ['bcr_patient_barcode', 'lactate_dehydrogenase_result']]
clin_sub = clin_sub.set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')

# 3. Aggregate gene expression to patient-level
# Map samples to patient IDs (first 12 characters)
sample_to_patient = expr.columns.str[:12]
expr_patient = expr.groupby(sample_to_patient, axis=1).mean()

# 4. Subset to patients in clinical subset
patients = expr_patient.columns.intersection(clin_sub.index)
expr_patient = expr_patient[patients]
labels = clin_sub.loc[patients, 'lactate_dehydrogenase_result']

# Transpose for ease: patients x genes
df_pat = expr_patient.T

groups = {'Normal': df_pat.index[labels == 'Normal'],
          'Elevated': df_pat.index[labels == 'Elevated']}

# 5. Differential expression analysis: t-test and logFC
genes = expr_patient.index
pvals = np.empty(len(genes))
logFC = np.empty(len(genes))
for i, gene in enumerate(genes):
    vals_normal = df_pat.loc[groups['Normal'], gene]
    vals_elev = df_pat.loc[groups['Elevated'], gene]
    # log2 fold change (Elevated vs Normal)
    logFC[i] = vals_elev.mean() - vals_normal.mean()
    # Welch's t-test
    _, pvals[i] = stats.ttest_ind(vals_elev, vals_normal, equal_var=False)

# Adjust p-values
_, fdr, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method='fdr_bh')

de_results = pd.DataFrame({'gene': genes, 'logFC': logFC, 'pval': pvals, 'FDR': fdr})
# Sort by FDR
de_results = de_results.sort_values('FDR').set_index('gene')

# Show top DE results
print("Top 10 DE genes:")
print(de_results.head(10))

# 6. Heatmap of top 50 DE genes
top50 = de_results.head(50).index.tolist()
heat_data = df_pat[top50].T
# Column colors by group
col_colors = labels.map({'Normal': 'blue', 'Elevated': 'red'})
# Clustered heatmap
sns.set(context='notebook', style='white')
g = sns.clustermap(
    heat_data, col_colors=col_colors, cmap='vlag', figsize=(12, 10),
    xticklabels=False, yticklabels=True
)
plt.suptitle('Top 50 DE Genes Heatmap by LDH Group')
plt.show()

# 7. Pathway enrichment on top 200 DE genes
top200 = de_results.head(200).index.tolist()
# Use Enrichr via gseapy
enr = gp.enrichr(
    gene_list=top200,
    gene_sets='GO_Biological_Process_2018',
    organism='Human',
    outdir=None,
    cutoff=0.05
)

# Show enrichment results
enrich_res = enr.results[['Term', 'P-value', 'Adjusted P-value']]
print("Top 10 enriched GO BP terms:")
print(enrich_res.head(10))

Extract MKI67 expression values from the gene expression matrix. 4. If multiple samples per patient exist, average MKI67 expression. 5. cluster_nodes.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Filter patients with Breslow thickness
clin_filt = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'breslow_thickness']].dropna(subset=['breslow_thickness'])

# 3. Extract MKI67 expression via Ensembl ID (MKI67: ENSG00000148773)
ensembl_prefix = 'ENSG00000148773'
matching = expr.index[expr.index.str.startswith(ensembl_prefix)]
if matching.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"No Ensembl ID starting with {ensembl_prefix} found in expression data.")
ensembl_id = matching[0]
mki67_expr = expr.loc[ensembl_id].rename('MKI67')

# 4. Map samples to patients and average if needed
sample_to_patient = mki67_expr.index.to_series().str[:12]
mki67_df = (pd.DataFrame({'patient': sample_to_patient, 'MKI67': mki67_expr.values})
             .groupby('patient', as_index=True)
             .mean())

# 5. Merge Breslow thickness and MKI67 expression
df = (clin_filt.set_index('bcr_patient_barcode')[['breslow_thickness']]
      .join(mki67_df, how='inner'))

# 6. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['breslow_thickness'], df['MKI67'])
print(f"Spearman correlation between Breslow thickness and MKI67 expression: rho={rho:.3f}, p-value={pval:.4g}")

# 7. Summary statistics
desc = df.agg(['mean', 'median', 'min', 'max']).T
print("\nSummary statistics:")
print(desc)

# 8. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.scatter(df['breslow_thickness'], df['MKI67'], alpha=0.6)
plt.xlabel('Breslow Thickness (mm)')
plt.ylabel('MKI67 Expression (log2 FPKM)')
plt.title('Breslow Thickness vs MKI67 Expression')

# Add LOWESS trend line
try:
    from statsmodels.nonparametric.smoothers_lowess import lowess
    smoothed = lowess(df['MKI67'], df['breslow_thickness'], frac=0.3)
    plt.plot(smoothed[:,0], smoothed[:,1], color='red', lw=2)
except ImportError:
    # Linear fit fallback
    m, b = np.polyfit(df['breslow_thickness'], df['MKI67'], 1)
    xs = np.linspace(df['breslow_thickness'].min(), df['breslow_thickness'].max(), 100)
    plt.plot(xs, m*xs + b, color='red', lw=2)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Dependencies
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy'); import gseapy as gp
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene'); import mygene

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map Ensembl IDs to symbols
ensembl = [i.split('.')[0] for i in expr.index]
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
mg_res = mg.querymany(ensembl, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', as_dataframe=True)
sym_map = mg_res['symbol'].to_dict()
expr['symbol'] = [sym_map.get(e) for e in ensembl]
expr = expr.dropna(subset=['symbol']).set_index('symbol')
expr = expr.groupby(expr.index).mean()

# 3. BRAF status
samples = expr.columns
pat_map = {s: s[:12] for s in samples}
braf = mut[(mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & (mut['Variant_Classification']=='Missense_Mutation')]
mut_pats = set(braf['patient_id'])
status = pd.Series({s: ('Mutant' if pat_map[s] in mut_pats else 'Wild-type') for s in samples})
status = status[expr.columns]

# 4. MAPK gene set
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg_lib = next(l for l in libs if l.startswith('KEGG'))
kegg = gp.get_library(name=kegg_lib, organism='Human')
mapk_key = next(k for k in kegg if 'MAPK SIGNALING PATHWAY' in k.upper())
mapk_genes = set(kegg[mapk_key])
common = sorted(mapk_genes & set(expr.index))
print(f"Overlapping MAPK genes: {len(common)}")

# 5. DE MAPK genes
de_list = []
for g in common:
    vals = expr.loc[g]
    m_vals = vals[status=='Mutant']
    w_vals = vals[status=='Wild-type']
    stat, p = ttest_ind(m_vals, w_vals, nan_policy='omit')
    de_list.append((g, m_vals.mean()-w_vals.mean(), p))
de_df = pd.DataFrame(de_list, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue']).set_index('gene')
de_df['FDR'] = multipletests(de_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_df = de_df.sort_values('FDR')

# 6. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sig = de_df['FDR']<0.05
plt.scatter(de_df['logFC'], -np.log10(de_df['FDR']), c=sig.map({True:'red',False:'gray'}), alpha=0.7)
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2FC (Mutant - WT)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 FDR')
plt.title('Volcano: MAPK Genes')
for g in de_df[sig].index[:5]:
    x, y = de_df.loc[g,'logFC'], -np.log10(de_df.loc[g,'FDR'])
    plt.text(x, y, g)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 7. Module score (mean and median)

mod_med = expr.loc[common].median()

import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

# Imports
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# gseapy
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy')
    import gseapy as gp
# mygene
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene')
    import mygene

# 1. Load data
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map Ensembl to symbols
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
ensembl_ids = [i.split('.')[0] for i in expr.index]
mapping = mg.querymany(ensembl_ids, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', as_dataframe=True)
mapd = mapping['symbol'].to_dict()
sym = [mapd.get(e) for e in ensembl_ids]
expr['symbol'] = sym
expr = expr[expr['symbol'].notna()]
expr = expr.set_index('symbol').groupby('symbol').mean()

# 3. BRAF status
samples = expr.columns.tolist()
pat_map = {s: s[:12] for s in samples}
braf = mut[(mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & (mut['Variant_Classification']=='Missense_Mutation')]
mut_pats = set(braf['patient_id'])
status = pd.Series({s: ('Mutant' if pat_map[s] in mut_pats else 'Wild-type') for s in samples})
status = status.loc[expr.columns]

# 4. KEGG MAPK gene set
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg = [x for x in libs if x.startswith('KEGG')][0]
sets = gp.get_library(name=kegg, organism='Human')
mapk_key = [k for k in sets if 'MAPK' in k.upper()][0]
mapk_genes = set(sets[mapk_key])
common = sorted(mapk_genes & set(expr.index))
print(f"MAPK genes overlapping expression data: {len(common)}")

# 5. Differential expression
res = []
for gene in common:
    vals = expr.loc[gene]
    m = vals[status=='Mutant']
    w = vals[status=='Wild-type']
    stat, p = ttest_ind(m, w, nan_policy='omit')
    logfc = m.mean() - w.mean()
    res.append((gene, logfc, p))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue']).set_index('gene')
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
res_df = res_df.sort_values('FDR')

# 6. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sig = res_df['FDR']<0.05
plt.scatter(res_df['logFC'], -np.log10(res_df['FDR']), c=sig.map({True:'red',False:'gray'}), alpha=0.7)
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2FC (Mutant - WT)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 FDR')
plt.title('Volcano: MAPK Genes')
for gene in res_df[sig].index[:5]:
    x,y = res_df.loc[gene,'logFC'], -np.log10(res_df.loc[gene,'FDR'])
    plt.text(x,y,gene)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 7. Module score boxplot
mod = expr.loc[common].mean()
df_mod = pd.DataFrame({'score': mod, 'status': status})
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5))
sns.boxplot(x='status', y='score', data=df_mod)
sns.stripplot(x='status', y='score', data=df_mod, color='black', size=3, jitter=True)
_, p_mod = mannwhitneyu(df_mod[df_mod.status=='Mutant']['score'], df_mod[df_mod.status=='Wild-type']['score'])
plt.text(0.5, df_mod['score'].max(), f'p={p_mod:.2e}', ha='center')
plt.title('MAPK Module Score by BRAF Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Print DE genes
sig_de = res_df[res_df['FDR']<0.05][['logFC','pvalue','FDR']]
print("\nDE MAPK genes (FDR<0.05):")
print(sig_de if not sig_de.empty else "None")

# 9. GSEA preranked
t_stats = []
for g in expr.index:
    vals = expr.loc[g]
    stat, _ = ttest_ind(vals[status=='Mutant'], vals[status=='Wild-type'], nan_policy='omit')
    t_stats.append(stat)
rnk = pd.DataFrame({'gene': expr.index, 'score': t_stats}).dropna().sort_values('score', ascending=False)
pre = gp.prerank(rnk=rnk, gene_sets={mapk_key: common}, outdir=None, permutation_num=100, seed=42, verbose=False)
# extract first row
gsea_res = pre.res2d.iloc[0]
print("\nGSEA MAPK pathway results:")
print(gsea_res[['es','nes','pval','fdr']])
# plot
from gseapy.plot import gseaplot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
gseaplot(pre.ranking, term=pre.res2d.index[0], **pre.results[mapk_key])
plt.show()"}

{"code":"import subprocess
import sys

def install(pkg): subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', '--quiet', 'install', pkg])

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Dependencies
try:
    import gseapy as gp
except ImportError:
    install('gseapy'); import gseapy as gp
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install('mygene'); import mygene

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map Ensembl IDs to symbols
ensembl = [i.split('.')[0] for i in expr.index]
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
mg_res = mg.querymany(ensembl, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', as_dataframe=True)
sym_map = mg_res['symbol'].to_dict()
expr['symbol'] = [sym_map.get(e) for e in ensembl]
expr = expr.dropna(subset=['symbol']).set_index('symbol')
expr = expr.groupby(expr.index).mean()

# 3. BRAF status
samples = expr.columns
pat_map = {s: s[:12] for s in samples}
braf = mut[(mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & (mut['Variant_Classification']=='Missense_Mutation')]
mut_pats = set(braf['patient_id'])
status = pd.Series({s: ('Mutant' if pat_map[s] in mut_pats else 'Wild-type') for s in samples})
status = status[expr.columns]

# 4. MAPK gene set
libs = gp.get_library_name(organism='Human')
kegg_lib = next(l for l in libs if l.startswith('KEGG'))
kegg = gp.get_library(name=kegg_lib, organism='Human')
mapk_key = next(k for k in kegg if 'MAPK SIGNALING PATHWAY' in k.upper())
mapk_genes = set(kegg[mapk_key])
common = sorted(mapk_genes & set(expr.index))
print(f"Overlapping MAPK genes: {len(common)}")

# 5. DE MAPK genes
de_list = []
for g in common:
    vals = expr.loc[g]
    m_vals = vals[status=='Mutant']
    w_vals = vals[status=='Wild-type']
    stat, p = ttest_ind(m_vals, w_vals, nan_policy='omit')
    de_list.append((g, m_vals.mean()-w_vals.mean(), p))
de_df = pd.DataFrame(de_list, columns=['gene','logFC','pvalue']).set_index('gene')
de_df['FDR'] = multipletests(de_df['pvalue'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
de_df = de_df.sort_values('FDR')

# 6. Volcano plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
sig = de_df['FDR']<0.05
plt.scatter(de_df['logFC'], -np.log10(de_df['FDR']), c=sig.map({True:'red',False:'gray'}), alpha=0.7)
plt.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color='blue', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Log2FC (Mutant - WT)')
plt.ylabel('-Log10 FDR')
plt.title('Volcano: MAPK Genes')
for g in de_df[sig].index[:5]:
    x, y = de_df.loc[g,'logFC'], -np.log10(de_df.loc[g,'FDR'])
    plt.text(x, y, g)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 7. Module score (mean and median)
mod_mean = expr.loc[common].mean()
mod_med = expr.loc[common].median()
mdf = pd.DataFrame({'mean_score':mod_mean, 'median_score':mod_med, 'status':status})
# Mean
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5)); sns.boxplot(x='status', y='mean_score', data=mdf); sns.stripplot(x='status', y='mean_score', data=mdf, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
p1 = mannwhitneyu(mdf[mdf.status=='Mutant']['mean_score'], mdf[mdf.status=='Wild-type']['mean_score']).pvalue
plt.title(f'Mean score (p={p1:.2e})'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
# Median
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5)); sns.boxplot(x='status', y='median_score', data=mdf); sns.stripplot(x='status', y='median_score', data=mdf, color='k', size=3, jitter=True)
p2 = mannwhitneyu(mdf[mdf.status=='Mutant']['median_score'], mdf[mdf.status=='Wild-type']['median_score']).pvalue
plt.title(f'Median score (p={p2:.2e})'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 8. Adjusted linear model (mean_score ~ status + age + clark_level)
cov = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode','age_at_diagnosis','clark_level']].dropna().drop_duplicates('bcr_patient_barcode')
lm = pd.DataFrame({'sample':expr.columns,'mean_score':mod_mean.values,'status':status.values})
lm['patient'] = lm['sample'].str[:12]
lm = lm.merge(cov, left_on='patient', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode')
model = ols('mean_score ~ C(status) + age_at_diagnosis + C(clark_level)', data=lm).fit()
print("\nLinear model summary:")
print(model.summary())

# 9. GSEA prerank
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
t_stats=[]
for g in expr.index:
    v=expr.loc[g]; st,_=ttest_ind(v[status=='Mutant'],v[status=='Wild-type'],nan_policy='omit'); t_stats.append(st)
rnk=pd.DataFrame({'Term':expr.index,'Score':t_stats}).dropna().sort_values('Score',ascending=False)
pre = gp.prerank(rnk=rnk, gene_sets={mapk_key:common}, outdir=None, permutation_num=1000, seed=42, verbose=False)
gsea = pre.res2d.iloc[0]
print("\nGSEA prerank results:")
print(gsea[['ES','NES','NOM p-val','FDR q-val']])
# Enrichment plot
from gseapy.plot import gseaplot
gseaplot(pre.ranking, **pre.results[mapk_key]); plt.show()

# 10. Print DE MAPK genes
sig_de = de_df[de_df['FDR']<0.05]
print(f"\nDE MAPK genes (FDR<0.05): {len(sig_de)} genes")
print(sig_de[['logFC','pvalue','FDR']])"}

hypothesis: Patients who received prior systemic therapy have higher tumor mutational burden than those who did not.

experiment_plan.objective: Evaluate the effect of prior systemic therapy on TMB.
experiment_plan.steps:
1. Load cleaned_clinical_data.csv and cleaned_mutations.csv.  
2. Compute TMB for each patient.  
3. From clinical data, extract prior_systemic_therapy (YES vs NO) and merge with TMB.  
4. Filter to patients with non‐missing prior_systemic_therapy.  
5. Compare TMB distributions between YES vs NO groups using a Wilcoxon rank‐sum test.  
6. Optionally, fit a linear regression (TMB ~ prior_systemic_therapy + age_at_diagnosis + gender) to adjust for covariates.
experiment_plan.deliverables:
• Boxplot or violin plot of TMB by prior_systemic_therapy status.  
• Wilcoxon test statistic and p‐value.  
• Optional regression results (coefficients, p‐values).  
• Table of patient_id, prior_systemic_therapy, and TMB.

code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')

# 2. Compute TMB per patient (raw mutation count)
tmb = mutations.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# 3. Prepare clinical subset and merge
tbl = clinical[['submitter_id', 'prior_systemic_therapy', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']]
tbl = tbl.rename(columns={'submitter_id': 'patient_id'})
# 4. Filter non-missing prior_systemic_therapy
tbl = tbl[tbl['prior_systemic_therapy'].isin(['YES', 'NO'])]
# Merge with TMB
merged = pd.merge(tbl, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 5. Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Mann-Whitney U)
grp_yes = merged.loc[merged['prior_systemic_therapy']=='YES', 'TMB']
grp_no  = merged.loc[merged['prior_systemic_therapy']=='NO', 'TMB']
st, p = mannwhitneyu(grp_yes, grp_no, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Wilcoxon rank-sum test: U={st:.1f}, p-value={p:.3e}")

# 6. Plot TMB by prior_systemic_therapy
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
merged.boxplot(column='TMB', by='prior_systemic_therapy', grid=False)
plt.title('TMB by Prior Systemic Therapy')
plt.suptitle('')
plt.xlabel('Prior Systemic Therapy')
plt.ylabel('Tumor Mutational Burden')
plt.show()

# Optional: linear regression adjusting for age and gender
# Convert categorical to factors automatically via formula
model = smf.ols('TMB ~ C(prior_systemic_therapy) + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=merged).fit()
print('\nRegression results:')
print(f"R^2 = {model.rsquared:.3f}\n")
print(model.summary().tables[1])  # coefficients and p-values

# 7. Show sample of merged table
tbl_out = merged[['patient_id', 'prior_systemic_therapy', 'TMB']]
print(f"\nMerged table (n={tbl_out.shape[0]} patients), first 5 rows:")
print(tbl_out.head().to_string(index=False))

import subprocess
import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

# Imports
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, mannwhitneyu

# mygene mapping
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    install("mygene")
    import mygene

# 1. Load data
df_clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
df_expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Map CD8A symbol to Ensembl ID
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
hit = mg.query('CD8A', fields='ensembl.gene', species='human', size=1)['hits'][0]
ensembl = hit.get('ensembl')
if isinstance(ensembl, list):
    ens_id = ensembl[0]['gene']
elif isinstance(ensembl, dict):
    ens_id = ensembl['gene']
else:
    raise ValueError('Unexpected ensembl mapping')

# 3. Extract CD8A expression
mask = df_expr.index.str.startswith(ens_id)
if not mask.any():
    raise KeyError(f"No gene matches Ensembl ID {ens_id}")
cd8a_series = df_expr.loc[mask].iloc[0]
cd8a_df = cd8a_series.reset_index()
cd8a_df.columns = ['sample', 'CD8A_expression']
cd8a_df['patient_id'] = cd8a_df['sample'].str[:12]

# 4. Merge with clinical mitotic count
df = pd.merge(cd8a_df, df_clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'mitotic_count_per_mm2']],
              left_on='patient_id', right_on='bcr_patient_barcode', how='left')
# Drop missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=['CD8A_expression', 'mitotic_count_per_mm2'])

# 5. Spearman correlation
rho, p_spearman = spearmanr(df['CD8A_expression'], df['mitotic_count_per_mm2'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {p_spearman:.3e}")

# 6. Scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.scatterplot(x='CD8A_expression', y='mitotic_count_per_mm2', data=df)
plt.xlabel('CD8A Expression (log2 FPKM)')
plt.ylabel('Mitotic count per mm^2')
plt.title(f'Scatter: CD8A vs Mitotic Count\nSpearman rho={rho:.2f}, p={p_spearman:.2e}')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 7. Dichotomize at median and Wilcoxon test
df['CD8A_group'] = np.where(df['CD8A_expression'] >= df['CD8A_expression'].median(), 'High', 'Low')
grp_high = df.loc[df['CD8A_group']=='High', 'mitotic_count_per_mm2']
grp_low = df.loc[df['CD8A_group']=='Low', 'mitotic_count_per_mm2']
stat, p_wilcox = mannwhitneyu(grp_high, grp_low, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Wilcoxon rank-sum test: U = {stat:.1f}, p-value = {p_wilcox:.3e}")

# 8. Boxplot of mitotic count by CD8A group
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.boxplot(x='CD8A_group', y='mitotic_count_per_mm2', data=df, palette=['skyblue','salmon'])
plt.xlabel('CD8A Group')
plt.ylabel('Mitotic count per mm^2')
plt.title(f'Mitotic Count by CD8A Group\nWilcoxon p={p_wilcox:.2e}')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import subprocess, sys

# Install mygene if missing
try:
    import mygene
except ImportError:
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', 'mygene'])
    import mygene

# 1. Load mutation and expression data
mut_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['Hugo_Symbol','HGVSp_Short','patient_id'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Identify BRAF V600E mutant patients
braf_mask = (mut_df['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & mut_df['HGVSp_Short'].str.contains('V600E', na=False)
braf_mut_patients = set(mut_df.loc[braf_mask, 'patient_id'])

# 3. Prepare sample metadata
samples = expr.columns.tolist()
patient_ids = [s[:12] for s in samples]
braf_status = ['Mutant' if pid in braf_mut_patients else 'WT' for pid in patient_ids]
meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': samples, 'patient_id': patient_ids, 'braf_status': braf_status})

# 4. Map MAPK pathway HUGO symbols to Ensembl IDs
genes = ['MAPK1','MAPK3','RAF1','MEK1','MEK2']
mg = mygene.MyGeneInfo()
query = mg.querymany(genes, scopes='symbol', fields='ensembl.gene', species='human')
# Extract Ensembl IDs
hugo2ens = {}
for entry in query:
    sym = entry['query']
    en = entry.get('ensembl')
    if isinstance(en, list): en = en[0]
    ens_id = en['gene'] if isinstance(en, dict) else en
    if ens_id:
        hugo2ens[sym] = ens_id.split('.')[0]
# Identify found and missing
found = [g for g in genes if g in hugo2ens]
missing = [g for g in genes if g not in hugo2ens]
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: Could not map symbols: {', '.join(missing)}")
# 5. Subset expression for mapped genes
ens_ids = list(hugo2ens.values())
# Match index: strip version from expr.index
idx_strip = expr.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0]
expr_index_map = dict(zip(idx_strip.index, idx_strip.values))
matched = []
for sym, ens in hugo2ens.items():
    matches = [orig for orig, base in expr_index_map.items() if base == ens]
    if matches:
        matched.append((sym, matches[0]))
    else:
        print(f"Warning: Ensembl {ens} for {sym} not found in expression data.")
# Build DataFrame of sample x symbol
expr_sub = pd.DataFrame({sym: expr.loc[idx, :].values for sym, idx in matched},
                        index=expr.columns)
expr_sub.index.name = 'sample'
expr_sub = expr_sub.reset_index()

# 6. Merge metadata and expression
df = meta.merge(expr_sub, on='sample')

# 7. Differential expression tests
results = []
for sym, _ in matched:
    muts = df.loc[df['braf_status']=='Mutant', sym].dropna()
    wts = df.loc[df['braf_status']=='WT', sym].dropna()
    if len(muts) < 2 or len(wts) < 2:
        print(f"Skipping {sym}: insufficient samples.")
        continue
    stat, pval = ttest_ind(muts, wts, equal_var=False)
    mean_mut = muts.mean()
    mean_wt = wts.mean()
    diff = mean_mut - mean_wt
    # fold change on original scale
    fc = 2 ** diff
    results.append({'gene': sym,
                    'mean_mutant': mean_mut,
                    'mean_wt': mean_wt,
                    'mean_diff': diff,
                    'fold_change': fc,
                    'p_value': pval})
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
if not res_df.empty:
    res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['p_value'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
    print("\nDifferential expression results:")
    print(res_df.to_string(index=False, float_format='%.4f'))
else:
    print("No genes tested. Check mapping and sample counts.")

# 8. Boxplots
if not df.empty and matched:
    melt_df = df.melt(id_vars=['sample','braf_status'], value_vars=[sym for sym, _ in matched],
                      var_name='gene', value_name='expression')
    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
    sns.boxplot(x='gene', y='expression', hue='braf_status', data=melt_df, palette='Set2')
    plt.title('MAPK Pathway Gene Expression by BRAF V600E Status')
    plt.xlabel('Gene')
    plt.ylabel('Expression (log2 FPKM)')
    plt.legend(title='BRAF Status')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("No data to plot.")

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
clin_mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['Hugo_Symbol','HGVSp_Short','patient_id'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Identify BRAF V600E patients
braf_mut = clin_mut[(clin_mut['Hugo_Symbol']=='BRAF') & clin_mut['HGVSp_Short'].str.contains('V600E', na=False)]
braf_mut_patients = set(braf_mut['patient_id'].unique())

# 3. Prepare sample-level status
# sample barcodes in expr columns, patient_id is first 12 chars
samples = expr.columns.tolist()
patient_ids = [s[:12] for s in samples]
braf_status = ['Mutant' if pid in braf_mut_patients else 'WT' for pid in patient_ids]
meta = pd.DataFrame({'sample': samples, 'patient_id': patient_ids, 'braf_status': braf_status})

# 4. Extract MAPK pathway genes
genes = ['MAPK1','MAPK3','RAF1','MEK1','MEK2']
# Check availability
avail = [g for g in genes if g in expr.index]
missing = set(genes) - set(avail)
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: genes not found in expression data: {', '.join(missing)}")
expr_sub = expr.loc[avail].T  # now samples x genes
expr_sub = expr_sub.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'sample'})
# Merge with status
df = meta.merge(expr_sub, on='sample')

# 5. Differential expression tests
results = []
for gene in avail:
    grp = df[['braf_status', gene]]
    muts = grp.loc[grp['braf_status']=='Mutant', gene].dropna()
    wts = grp.loc[grp['braf_status']=='WT', gene].dropna()
    stat, pval = ttest_ind(muts, wts, equal_var=False)
    mean_mut = muts.mean()
    mean_wt = wts.mean()
    diff = mean_mut - mean_wt
    fc = 2 ** diff
    results.append({'gene': gene,
                    'mean_mutant': mean_mut,
                    'mean_wt': mean_wt,
                    'mean_diff': diff,
                    'fold_change': fc,
                    'p_value': pval})
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
# adjust p-values
res_df['FDR'] = multipletests(res_df['p_value'], method='fdr_bh')[1]
res_df = res_df[['gene','mean_mutant','mean_wt','mean_diff','fold_change','p_value','FDR']]
print("Differential expression results:")
print(res_df.to_string(index=False, float_format='%.4f'))

# 6. Boxplots
melt_df = df.melt(id_vars=['sample','braf_status'], value_vars=avail,
                  var_name='gene', value_name='expression')
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='gene', y='expression', hue='braf_status', data=melt_df, palette='Set2')
plt.title('MAPK Pathway Gene Expression by BRAF V600E Status')
plt.xlabel('Gene')
plt.ylabel('Expression (log2 FPKM)')
plt.legend(title='BRAF Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}

import numpy as np

# define non-synonymous as Variant_Classification != 'Silent'
ns = mut[mut['Variant_Classification'] != 'Silent']
# count per patient_id
tmb = ns.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# 2. Load clinical data and derive survival
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
# ensure patient_id column matches

clin['time'] = clin['days_to_death'].fillna(clin['days_to_last_followup'])
clin['event'] = clin['days_to_death'].notna().astype(int)
# select covariates
covs = clin[['patient_id', 'time', 'event', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender', 'ajcc_pathologic_stage_raw']]

# 3. Merge
df = pd.merge(covs, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')
# drop missing
df = df.dropna(subset=['time', 'event', 'TMB', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender', 'ajcc_pathologic_stage_raw'])

# encode categorical
df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['gender', 'ajcc_pathologic_stage_raw'], drop_first=True)

# 4. Cox model

cph.fit(df.drop(columns=['patient_id']), duration_col='time', event_col='event')

# 5. Proportional hazards check

cph.check_assumptions(df.drop(columns=['patient_id']), show_plots=False, p_value_threshold=0.05)

# 6. Kaplan-Meier by TMB tertiles

    kmf.fit(df.loc[mask,'time'], event_observed=df.loc[mask,'event'], label=group)

plt.title('Survival by TMB Tertiles')

plt.ylabel('Survival Probability')

# log-rank test
results = multivariate_logrank_test(df['time'], df['TMB_tertile'], df['event'])
print(f"Log-rank test p-value: {results.p_value:.4f}")

# 7. Output dataset
out = df[['patient_id','time','event','TMB','age_at_diagnosis'] + 
         [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('gender_') or col.startswith('ajcc_pathologic_stage_raw_')]]

experiment_plan.steps:

6. Merge with clinical annotation of multiple primaries.
